openedCandidateSequence.evidenceConsequence: Waiting for three-way equality selects the terminal observed state after source convergence. The first pointer-exact state already has owner and layer-state equality while source differs, and its watched source and layer-state addresses are reused later in the same frozen sequence.

openedCallbackFailure.message: capture_writer_watchpoint() takes 2 positional arguments but 3 were given

hardwareIndexCorrection.falsifiedRule: Four distinct nonnegative SBWatchpoint.GetHardwareIndex values identify four hardware watchpoints.
hardwareIndexCorrection.officialContract: GetHardwareIndex is deprecated and always returns -1 because the hardware register index cannot be determined reliably through gdb-remote.
hardwareIndexCorrection.replacementRule: Require four distinct positive SBWatchpoint IDs, exact preregistered addresses and eight-byte sizes, successful WatchAddress creation, deprecatedHardwareIndex=-1, and at least one changed-value QuartzCore callback event for every watched field.

frozenRetryDelta.selectionRule: Select the first symbol+0x2b58 invocation with the exact nonzero x19/x20/x24/layerState pointer chain, exact owner+0xe0 equals layerState+0xb0 rectangle identity, and source+0x50 different from layerState+0xb0. Record all three rectangles and their raw bytes before arming.
frozenRetryDelta.selectionPurpose: Arm before the source rectangle converges so reused source, owner, owner-region, and layer-state storage can expose their write sites. This is an evidence-derived preconvergence state, not a relaxed claim that the three rectangles are already identical.

frozenQuestion.objective: Arm the unchanged four watchpoints in the first exact preconvergence object state and capture the Apple instructions that update reused source, owner, owner-region, and layer-state crop storage before terminal equality.
frozenQuestion.entryRule: Set one pending breakpoint by the exact capture_backdrop symbol. On its first hit, read exactly 0x4000 bytes from the symbol address and require SHA-256 14f25960556bec9e88ba8ade176ee7f1d39b84726226ade3eb1b0f1be00b70d2 before setting the bounded candidate breakpoint at symbol+0x2b58.
frozenQuestion.candidateRule: Inspect at most 512 symbol+0x2b58 invocations. A selected candidate must require source=x19, owner=x20, layer=x24, layerState=*(layer+0x10), *(source+0x48)=owner, *(layerState+0x120)=source, owner+0xe0 exactly equal to layerState+0xb0 under binary64/int32 decoding, and source+0x50 not equal to layerState+0xb0. Retain exact raw rectangle bytes.
frozenQuestion.watchpointRule: On the first exact preconvergence candidate, arm exactly four 8-byte write-on-modify watchpoints: source+0x50, owner+0xe0, owner+0x248, and that candidate's layerState+0xb0. Retain at most six changed-value events per watchpoint and at most 24 events total. The three-argument callback ignores its internal-dictionary argument, never mutates target memory, and returns false to resume the target.
frozenQuestion.watchpointIdentityRule: Require four distinct positive SBWatchpoint IDs and exact addresses/sizes. Require the documented deprecated hardware-index value -1 rather than inventing hardware-register identities. Actual changed-value callbacks at every address are mandatory.
frozenQuestion.eventRule: For each event retain the exact before and after eight bytes, stop PC, thread ID, at most 32 frames, all six private post-write fields, and one deduplicated mapped code window. A resolved writer symbol retains exactly 0x1000 bytes from its symbol start; an unresolved writer retains exactly 0x400 bytes beginning 0x200 bytes before the stop PC.
frozenQuestion.integrityRule: Require a selected exact preconvergence candidate, four distinct watchpoint IDs, at least one changed QuartzCore event for every preregistered field, contiguous per-field hit indices, exact code-window hashes, a normally completed target and timeline, zero LLDB failures, and a finalized raw trace.
frozenQuestion.semanticSeal: The CI validator may prove only preconvergence selection, trace integrity, and writer-PC capture. A destructor or allocator stop is not automatically a crop constructor; function semantics, writer order, arithmetic, and the public layer-state crop rule remain sealed until the artifact is opened after the run.
frozenQuestion.nullOutcome: A changed code hash, no exact preconvergence candidate within 512 invocations, callback exception, stopped target, missing timeline, missing field event, non-QuartzCore event inventory, partial code window, or any validator failure fails closed and remains an uploaded artifact.
